predictions.articleTitle: Saudi Arabia vs Uzbekistan Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Green Falcons Exploit Khusanov Void?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Saudi Arabia's Doha continuity and five-match winning momentum project them to avoid defeat against a Khusanov-less Uzbekistan side in a controlled, under-2.5-goal friendly.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw anchored by Saudi Arabia's Doha residency and Uzbekistan's winless away friendly defense (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals backed by a 2.25 combined lambda and 60.9% Poisson under-2.5 distribution (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Second-half breakthrough script driven by both teams' low first-half goal shares and Uzbekistan's late defensive fade (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Saudi Arabia's Doha winning streak tests Uzbekistan's Khusanov-less backline.

spf.comment: A 1:0 home win leads behind Doha continuity and Khusanov's absence, while a 1:1 draw covers Saudi flank absences and Uzbekistan's higher Elo rating, making a single call too narrow.

over_under.comment: A 2.25 combined lambda (60.9% under 2.5), Saudi Arabia's four recent Gulf Cup clean sheets, and Sultan Mandash's absence favor two or fewer goals.

score.comment: 1:0 captures Saudi Arabia breaking down a depleted Uzbek defense late, while 1:1 reflects the 13.3% modal Poisson stalemate if Shomurodov finds a counter.

goals.comment: Two goals (26.7%) and one goal (23.7%) hold half of the Poisson total-goals distribution around the 2.25 combined expectancy.

bqc.comment: Low first-half goal shares point to an even interval before Saudi Arabia exploits Uzbekistan's late fragility (Draw-Win) or rotation keeps it level (Draw-Draw).
